description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. D. R. Wijayalal has Vacated of Member that Welivitya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns a local authority election matter, declaring that a member of the Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party (Janasetha Peramuna). This falls under electoral processes and declarations, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) according to the classification system.
